backend/main.mo: Defines article and user profile types, manages articles and user profiles with access control, and exposes query/update methods for fetching and modifying data.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that drops the old articleSubmissions map and carries forward userProfiles and articles unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing feature updates, affected frontend files, components, and test IDs for recent product changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files including pages, hooks, and components.
frontend/index.css: TailwindCSS setup defining light and dark theme color variables and applying global background and text styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry page mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, theme provider, layout shell, and ties all pages including upload and article/event detail views.
frontend/src/components/articles/Article: Displays a clickable article preview card with title, date, promotion badge, optional breaking label, and snippet.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppHead: Sticky header with logo, global search input, and upload button, updating shared search state and navigating to the upload page.
frontend/src/components/home/BreakingBan: Displays a rotating breaking‑news banner that cycles through articles and navigates to the selected one.
frontend/src/components/layouts/TabShell: Provides a layout with header, bottom tabs, and a shared search context wrapping page content.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with icons and highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/news/NewsFilters: Shows dropdown filters for promotions and categories, passing selected values upward.
frontend/src/components/profile/LoginBut: Handles Internet Identity login/logout states and displays the appropriate button UI.
frontend/src/components/profile/Promotio: Allows users to toggle favorite promotions and saves updates to their profile.
frontend/src/components/promotions/Promo: Displays a promotion logo badge with sizing and automatic image selection based on name.
Renders a rumor entry showing status, promotion badge, summary, and extracted source.
frontend/src/components/rumors/StatusPil: Shows a styled label indicating rumor status such as confirmed, likely, or false.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useArticleActions.ts: Provides actions for saving articles and managing reading history tied to the user profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines Internet Identity context, creating and managing AuthClient state and login/logout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating articles, user profiles, saved articles, reading history, and uploads using an actor interface.
frontend/src/hooks/useTabMemory.ts: Stores and retrieves the last visited path per tab using an in-memory map with fallbacks to default paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeMode.ts: Syncs theme with user profile or local storage and provides a toggle that persists changes.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and custom color utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminApprovalPage.tsx: Empty placeholder page for admin approval functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUploadArticlePag: Empty placeholder page for admin article upload functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full article view with sharing, saving, and reading history integration.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx: Shows details for an event article with navigation back to events.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Lists event articles with search support and navigation to event details.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders home feed including breaking news, latest articles, trending stories, and search results.
frontend/src/pages/MatchDetailPage.tsx: Shows basic match details for a given event and provides navigation back to the event page.
frontend/src/pages/NewsPage.tsx: Renders the News page with category/promotion filters, search handling, and a list of news articles using ArticleCard.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays user profile, preferences, principal ID, saved articles, and reading history, with login gating and theme toggles.
frontend/src/pages/RumorsPage.tsx: Shows rumor articles with search support and a manual refresh button, rendering each item with RumorRow.
Provides an authenticated form to upload and immediately publish user-submitted news articles, with success and auth gating states.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, animations, and theming for dark mode and custom UI tokens.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, features, issues, and architectural notes for the wrestling news app OTC-R.
